browser.scope: Focused production suite, one worker and zero retries, local macOS Chromium and WebKit; CI unset, so existing strict local cadence thresholds apply.
browser.note: Initial 20 pass / 1 fail / 1 existing desktop skip. The airport test clicked while AIR loading was still displayed and targets were absent. It now waits for aria-busy=false and three rendered frames, preserving the original coordinates, assertions and timeouts. All six repeated Chromium/WebKit airport cases then pass. The strict local phone WebKit frame-cadence case passed. Hosted CI independently runs the complete suite.
